name: Massachusetts 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or a short-term 4-H program at a library or community center. Pick your own projects, build skills and enter competitions if you are 8 or older.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 8 to 18 (before January 1) can join and take part in projects and competitions. Ages 5 to 7 join as Cloverbuds and do not compete.
pay_detail: $40 per member each year, with a family cap of $120. Fee waivers can be requested through your 4-H Educator. The page says cash is not accepted.
duration: Annual membership; you re-enroll each year
deadline_text: No deadline posted. All members enroll every year.
how_to_apply: Contact your local 4-H office to learn about programs and get the New Member Enrollment Packet. Fill it out and return it. The office then tells your parent or guardian where to pay online or by check. Re-enroll through 4honline.
notes: A youth group, not a job. The Get Involved page still shows a 2022-2023 fee note, but the Membership page lists the $40 fee with a $120 family cap, so confirm the current fee with your local office.
